welcome.title: Welcome to AppChat 👋
welcome.body: You have a 15-day Personal Pro trial. Every feature of the plan is active until {date}.

perks.1: Unlimited Zalo, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Website and Email connections
perks.2: All department AI Agents — Sales, Customer care, Marketing, Operations
perks.3: Full CRM: customers, quotes, contracts, orders, invoices, loyalty
perks.4: Automation, reports and 10,000 trial AI credits

welcome.note: When the trial ends your account moves to the Free plan automatically. Your data is kept.

expired.title: Your trial has ended
expired.body: Your Personal Pro trial has ended. Your account has been moved to the Free plan — you can still sign in and use it within the plan limits.

locks.1: Only 1 channel kept — channels over the limit are paused
locks.2: Only 1 AI Agent kept — other agents are paused
locks.3: AI credits drop to 500 / month on the Free plan
locks.4: Advanced reports and automation are locked

expired.note: Your data is kept. Upgrading unlocks every feature right away.
